# symbolicUserItemsTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicUserItemsTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserItemsTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  exudyn.misc.symbolicUserItems.UserItemCreator (#3125): one script builds a chain of three mass points hanging
#           from the ground by spring-dampers, under gravity, a force of a user function of the time on the last
#           point, once with creator = mbs (MassPoint, ObjectConnectorSpringDamper) and once with
#           creator = UserItemCreator(mbs) (ObjectUserBody, ObjectConnectorUser). The user items with their Python
#           user functions and after Record with symbolic ones equal the built-in items, with the implicit solver and
#           with RK44; the system of the recorded user items as SymbolicSystem, one kind each, by SolveExplicit
#           equals SolveDynamic. The Create functions have the arguments of those of mbs; an argument the user item
#           does not support raises, naming it.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-27
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.misc.symbolicUserItems import UserItemCreator
from exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem import SymbolicSystem, SolveExplicit
import exudyn.cMath as cMath
import exudyn.graphics as graphics
import numpy as np
import inspect

def UFforce(mbs, t, loadVector):
    return cMath.sin(10*t)*loadVector #cMath: the function computes numbers and is recorded

def Chain(creator, mbs):
    """the chain, built with the Create functions of creator; returns the body numbers"""
    ground = creator.CreateGround()
    bodies = []
    previous = ground
    for i in range(3):
        bodies.append(creator.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[0.5*(i + 1), 0, 0], initialVelocity=[0, 0, 0.2*i],
                                              mass=0.5 + 0.1*i, gravity=[0, -9.81, 0], drawSize=0.1))
        creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[previous, bodies[-1]], stiffness=400, damping=2 + i, force=0.5*i,
                                   drawSize=0.02 if i == 0 else -1, color=graphics.color.red)
        previous = bodies[-1]
    creator.CreateForce(itemNumber=bodies[-1], loadVector=[1, 2, 0], loadVectorUserFunction=UFforce)
    return bodies

def Build(userItems, record=False):
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    creator = UserItemCreator(mbs) if userItems else mbs
    bodies = Chain(creator, mbs)
    if record:
        creator.Record()
    mbs.variables['creator'] = creator #the recordings live as long as the system
    mbs.Assemble()
    return (SC, mbs, bodies)

simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 400
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.4
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False

def Positions(mbs, bodies):
    return np.array([mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(body, exu.OutputVariableType.Position, localPosition=[0, 0, 0]) for body in bodies])

difference = 0. #of the user items to the built-in items
models = {}
for solverType in [exu.DynamicSolverType.GeneralizedAlpha, exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44]:
    results = []
    for (userItems, record) in [(False, False), (True, False), (True, True)]:
        (SC, mbs, bodies) = Build(userItems, record)
        mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings, solverType=solverType)
        results.append(Positions(mbs, bodies))
        models[(userItems, record)] = (SC, mbs, bodies)
    exu.Print(str(solverType) + ': Python user items', np.max(np.abs(results[1] - results[0])), ', recorded',
              np.max(np.abs(results[2] - results[0])), ', lowest point', results[0][:, 1].min())
    difference = max(difference, np.max(np.abs(results[1] - results[0])), np.max(np.abs(results[2] - results[0])))

#the recorded user items as SymbolicSystem, RK44 by SolveExplicit against SolveDynamic
(SC, mbs, bodies) = models[(True, True)]
system = SymbolicSystem(mbs)
exu.Print(system)
qExudyn = np.array(mbs.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates())
result = SolveExplicit(system, simulationSettings, solverType=exu.DynamicSolverType.RK44)
differenceExplicit = np.max(np.abs(result['q'][-1] - qExudyn))/np.max(np.abs(qExudyn))
exu.Print('SolveExplicit on the recorded user items against SolveDynamic:', differenceExplicit)

#the arguments of the Create functions are those of mbs
SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()
creator = UserItemCreator(mbs)
sameArguments = 0
for name in ['CreateGround', 'CreateMassPoint', 'CreateSpringDamper', 'CreateForce']:
    arguments = [list(inspect.signature(getattr(item, name)).parameters.items()) for item in [mbs, creator]]
    sameArguments += int([(key, value.default) for (key, value) in arguments[0]] ==
                         [(key, value.default) for (key, value) in arguments[1]])
exu.Print('Create functions with the arguments of mbs:', sameArguments, 'of 4')

#an argument the user item does not support raises, naming it
refused = 0
for (function, arguments, text) in [(creator.CreateMassPoint, dict(create2D=True), 'create2D'),
                                    (creator.CreateSpringDamper, dict(itemNumbers=[creator.CreateGround(), creator.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[1, 0, 0], mass=1)],
                                                                      springForceUserFunction=lambda *args: 0), 'springForceUserFunction')]:
    try:
        function(**arguments)
    except ValueError as e:
        refused += int(text in str(e))
exu.Print('refused, as they must be:', refused, 'of 2')

u = 1 + int(difference > 1e-12) + int(differenceExplicit > 1e-12) + (4 - sameArguments) + (2 - refused)
exu.Print('solution of symbolicUserItemsTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
